notes: Sequence design under a circular sliding-window composition constraint on an arbitrary named pair of bases (not just GC). Hard elements: circular wrap-around windows must satisfy the range (period-block tiling is the clean construction), an exact feasible-count k must be derived from fractional percentage bounds, plus secondary constraints (all four bases present, homopolymer runs capped at 4 including the seam) that break naive two-letter tilings. The verifier re-executes the designer on three hidden parameter cases with fresh lengths/windows/bounds/pairs and scans every window with exact rational arithmetic.
